heading: Services and prices
description: Everything this hospital charges for, and what each costs. A charge keeps the price it was posted at, so changing a price never changes an old bill.
backToList: Back to the list of services

form.codeHint: How the service is named on bills. Letters, digits, dots and dashes. It cannot be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.taxClassHint: Which tax rate applies. The rates themselves are set for the hospital, not here.
form.priceHint: Optional. A service can be set up first and priced later.

create.heading: Add a service
create.description: A service is one line a patient can be charged for.
create.codeTaken: This hospital already has a service with that code. It may be archived.

detail.notFoundBody: There is no such service at this hospital.
detail.errorTitle: The service could not be loaded
detail.archivedNote: This service is archived. It stays on the charges and bills that name it and is not offered for new ones.
detail.conflict: Someone else changed this service while you were editing. What you changed is still here: check it and save again. The fields you did not change keep what they saved.
detail.conflictToggle: Someone else changed this service just now. It has been updated: check it and try again.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.description: A price is never edited. A new price takes over from its own date and the one before it ends the day before.
prices.failed: The prices could not be loaded.
prices.none: This service has no price yet.
prices.effectiveFromHint: Today or a later date at this hospital.

errors.dateConflict: A price already starts on or after that date. Choose a later date, or withdraw the scheduled price first.
errors.inForce: That price is already in force, so it cannot be withdrawn. Set a new price instead.
errors.gone: That price is no longer there. The list has been updated.
